{
  "name": "side-chat",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Ask Claude a side question in a pane next to your work. The main conversation never sees it. Works like the desktop app's /btw.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Varun Moka",
    "url": "https://github.com/varunmoka7"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/varunmoka7/side-chat",
  "repository": "https://github.com/varunmoka7/side-chat",
  "keywords": [
    "agents",
    "btw",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "function-hooks",
    "productivity",
    "side-chat",
    "slash-command"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "yourColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Your text color",
      "description": "Colour of your questions in the side chat.",
      "options": [
        "cyan",
        "green",
        "yellow",
        "magenta",
        "blue",
        "red",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ],
      "default": "cyan"
    },
    "claudeColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Claude's text color",
      "description": "Colour of Claude's answers in the side chat.",
      "options": [
        "cyan",
        "green",
        "yellow",
        "magenta",
        "blue",
        "red",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ],
      "default": "white"
    },
    "instructions": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Side chat instructions",
      "description": "Your own instructions for the side chat, added to every question. Example: answer in plain words, two lines at most, no code unless asked.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "takeKeyboard": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Side chat takes the keyboard when opened",
      "description": "On: /btw puts the cursor in the side chat so you can type at once; press Esc to go back to the main prompt. Off: the main prompt keeps the keyboard, and dropped screenshots stay there; ask with /btw <question>.",
      "default": true
    },
    "agentModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Side chat agent model",
      "description": "Model for agents called with /btw @name. default: the agent's own model. Change it on the fly by typing /model haiku in the pane.",
      "options": [
        "default",
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus"
      ],
      "default": "default"
    }
  }
}
